knowledge:
- key_parameters: max_features=The maximum number of features to select and rank ;; conditions=Number of independent conditions per replicate (used in simData) ;; n_latent_factors=Number of latent factors to generate redundant features (used in simData) ;; replicates=Number of replicates (used in simData)
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Appropriate when you have high-dimensional data with replicated measurements across multiple conditions and want to reduce dimensionality by selecting a subset of highly reproducible, non-redundant features.
- pitfalls: None explicitly mentioned in the documentation, but the algorithm relies on having replicated measurements across conditions to calculate the replicate F-statistic.

workflows.name: unsupervised_feature_selection
workflows.intent: Select and rank a subset of highly reproducible, non-redundant features from high-dimensional replicated data.
input: SummarizedExperiment object containing replicated measurements across conditions (features x samples).
workflows.stages: 1. Perform feature selection and ranking using FeatSeek ;; 2. Visualize the selected features using plotSelectedFeatures
workflows.code:
sim <- simData(conditions=conditions, n_latent_factors=latent_factors,
                replicates=replicates)
res <- FeatSeek(sim, max_features=5)
plotSelectedFeatures(res)
